feature: Enhanced-tier findings whose check hit a real Microsoft Graph license gap (checkStatus='license_gap') now render a locked-state card (Lock icon, plain-language explanation, data-testid='license-gap-locked-card') instead of a blank/error-looking finding, reusing #1099's Copilot-readiness locked-card visual pattern (LicenseGapUpsellCard.tsx). Two real CTAs per Shane's confirmed hybrid (issue comment 2026-08-18): a self-serve link straight to Microsoft's own SKU pricing page (license-gap-purchase-links.ts, data-testid='license-gap-selfserve-link', never a resale), and a sales-assisted path (data-testid='license-gap-chat-cta') that opens ShaneBot with the migration intent pre-sent via the portal's existing useSupportChat()/sendMessage() mechanism, which always resolves the shanebot_paid instance server-side (route-keyed, no client instance selection needed). Wired into every findings render surface: TopicFindings.tsx (6 topic pages), IntelligenceSignals.tsx + RiskDetailDrawer.tsx (security-overview), TopicRemediationModal.tsx (governance/compliance/etc.), and MissionControl.tsx (dashboard home) — plus a compact Lock badge (in place of the severity chip) on the two Top-5 rank-list widgets (TopSecurityRisks.tsx, TopGovernanceRisks.tsx) whose detail drawer/modal shows the full card. portal-mission-control.ts's GET /overview mapper now resolves each license-gapped finding's tenant-tiered purchase recommendation (buildLicenseGapPurchase/recommendationForCheckKey) into a licenseGap field.
notes: REAL LIVE DATA CONFIRMED (shaneapp://executeSql, 2026-08-18): customer_id=1 (the TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL testbed tenant) has genuine checkStatus='license_gap' findings across all 3 license-gap-purchase-links.ts categories (identity:pim-eligible-roles, security:antiphishing-coverage, governance:retention-label-adoption, among ~18 other gapped check keys, 44-58 finding rows each across historical runs) — a real tier-3/consolidated-E7 recommendation case, not a hypothetical. Titles read e.g. 'Not checked — requires Microsoft Defender for Office 365' / 'requires Microsoft Entra ID P2 or Microsoft Entra ID Governance' / 'requires Microsoft Purview retention/eDiscovery capability'.

KNOWN, PRE-EXISTING GAP (same one documented in top-security-risks-quick-fix-chip.json and top-governance-risks.json, not introduced by this change): GET /api/portal/mission-control/overview is requireRole('CustomerUser'). The only standard test account (TEST_PORTAL_EMAIL/PASSWORD) is the pre-provisioned testbed 'Assessment' role, explicitly BELOW CustomerUser (requireAuth.ts ROLE_ORDER) — it gets a real 403 on this endpoint despite customer_id=1 (its own tenant) genuinely holding the license-gap findings above. This blocks live UI-driving of the locked card through the shared testbed account today. D1/UI D2-D3 below are marked non-critical for the same reason those two prior manifests already document — this is a test-infrastructure gap affecting the whole findings feed's live-data assertions, not specific to this feature. Fix: provision a CustomerUser-tier test account.

Server-side field shape (portal-mission-control.ts) and the client LicenseGapUpsellCard component were verified by direct code read + a clean tsc --noEmit on every touched file (both api-server and msp-portal packages) — not a live UI assertion for the locked-card's exact rendered content, documented honestly rather than faked given the account-tier gap above.
